title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Design themes, headers, and footers for document reports with the updated Word add-in
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 2 (BC29) introduces enhanced Word add-in capabilities for designing document report themes, headers, and footers. The update provides sample layouts for common documents like invoices and pick lists, plus five predefined header and footer templates that can be inserted with a single click, making complex report design faster and easier than RDLC.
key_points: BC29 adds three realistic sample documents to the Word add-in (Invoice, Pick List, Outstanding Orders) for testing themes against real content
Five predefined header layouts and five footer layouts can be inserted with one click and work for internal or external reports
Install the latest Business Central add-in for Word (3.0.0.0 is listed) to get the Business Central ribbon tab
Word layouts can have a Default or Body subtype, and Body layouts combine with reusable themes and header/footer parts
The author recommends moving from RDLC to Word layouts

quotes.text: A Word layout determines the report's content - controlling how that content elements are arranged and how they look.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core purpose and function of Word layouts in Business Central report design

quotes.text: It is definitely time to transition over to Word Layouts.
quotes.why_it_matters: Signals the author's recommendation to move away from RDLC layouts in favor of the improved Word layout capabilities
